scripts.text:
- Your pack is too heavy. -
- Lighten your body first -
- and please try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你的背包太重了。 -
- 請先減輕負重 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
Uh? What am I doing? I came here for an errand...
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
呃？我在做什麼？我是來這裡辦事的...

scripts.text: ^000099Maybe my feeling has moved to another body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099也許我的感覺已經轉移到另一個身體上了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
Oh you are so young. Keep working hard.
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
你看起來很年輕。繼續努力吧。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
You are dragging something. If you're riding something you better dismount it before proceeding.
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
你正拖著什麼東西。如果你正騎著坐騎，請先下馬再繼續前進。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
I don't have anything to say to you. Find another person.
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
我沒什麼話要對你說。去找別人吧。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
What was I saying... (mumble) the remaining segment is in Glast Heim around 13.......
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
我剛才在說什麼來著...（嘟囔）剩下的部分在葛拉斯特海姆的13號區域附近...

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
Uhh?
Did you need something?
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
呃？
你需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text: I haven't seen you before.
scripts.translation: 我好像沒見過你。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
Hehehe, don't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
呵呵呵，別擔心我。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
If you don't have business with me, just keep going my friend.
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
如果你沒有事找我，就請繼續趕路吧，朋友。

scripts.text: You don't look like a Knight...
scripts.translation: 你看起來不像是騎士...

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
You're a curious one. Who are you? What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
你還挺好奇的。你是誰？想要什麼？

scripts.text: Just looking around!
scripts.translation: 只是隨便看看！

scripts.text: This is my office!
scripts.translation: 這是我的辦公室！

scripts.text: Who am I? Who are you?
scripts.translation: 我是誰？你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
Do you want to argue with me? Do you know who I am?
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
你想跟我吵架嗎？你知道我是誰嗎？

scripts.text: Not really, who are you?
scripts.translation: 不太清楚，你是誰？

scripts.text: Sorry, I won't hurt your feelings.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不想傷害你的感情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry. I had to be sure. I didn't know that you are from the royal palace.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉。我必須確認一下。我不知道你是來自王宮的。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
That's enough. Don't make this mistake again.
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
夠了。別再犯這種錯誤了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm a member here and have the authority to find out what your business is here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是這裡的成員，有權調查你在此的目的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are a stranger and I'm not sure if you belong here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是個陌生人，我不確定你是否屬於這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you tell me your identity, I will apologize.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你告訴我你的身份，我會向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
You are so persistent.
If you really want, I will introduce myself.
scripts.translation:
[中年紳士]
你還真執著。
如果你真的想知道，我就自我介紹一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Middle-aged Gentleman]
I am Heinrich.
I'm collecting information about King Schmidtz's trace which has disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
我是海因裡希。
我正在收集關於失蹤的施密茨國王蹤跡的資訊。

scripts.text: Schmidzt's trace? Is it a treasure?
scripts.translation: 施密茨的蹤跡？那是寶物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Most archaeologists are eager to get treasure. I'm looking for traces of the ^000099Royal Guard^000000 and their sons who belong to the Schmidtz line.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
大多數考古學家都渴望得到寶物。但我尋找的是屬於施密茨家族的^000099皇家衛士^000000及其子嗣的蹤跡。

scripts.text: Royal Guard?
scripts.translation: 皇家衛士？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Sounds interesting doesn't it? I can't really say but their history and files are under strict security.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
聽起來很有趣，不是嗎？我其實不能多說什麼，但他們的歷史和檔案受到嚴格保密。

scripts.text: Can't you tell me?
scripts.translation: 你不能告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
I can't really talk about the Royal Guard to just anyone who asks about them.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
我不能隨便向任何人透露關於皇家衛士的事情。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
BUT!! I want to believe you...
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
但是！！我想相信你...

scripts.text: I want to know more.
scripts.translation: 我想知道更多。

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 別說了。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
You are impetuous.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你真是魯莽。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
It's not a simple story to tell a person like you. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
這不是一個能輕易講給你聽的故事。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
好主意。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Just forget it and let your mind do more worthy things.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
就忘了它吧，讓你的心思去做更有價值的事情。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
[Heinrich]
You are persistent friend.
Do you have more things to talk to me about?
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你還真執著，朋友。
你還有別的事要跟我說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Don't forget to bring 100 Burning Heart.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
別忘了帶100個燃燒的心臟。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Did you get all of them?
Most people just ignore me or give up the mission.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你都拿到了嗎？
大多數人要麼無視我，要麼放棄任務。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
...
Good. I can feel truth from your heart. Now I can tell you more of the story.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
...
很好。我能感受到你心中的真誠。現在我可以告訴你更多的故事了。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Our staff has already left to find the last trace, so don't work too hard.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
我的職員已經出發去尋找最後的線索了，所以你也別太累了。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
No, it's not the correct one that I want.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
不，這不是我想要的那個。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
What? Did you lose the shield? What is the one on your back?
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
什麼？你把盾牌弄丟了？那你背上背的是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Thanks to your help I can finish the excavation work. Thanks a lot.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
多虧你的幫忙，我才能完成挖掘工作。非常感謝。

scripts.text: [Heinrich]
scripts.translation: [海因裡希]

scripts.text: If you can't trust me, test me pal.
scripts.translation: 如果你不信任我，那就考驗我一下，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Test?
Did you say the test? Huhu!
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
考驗？
你剛才說考驗？呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Friend, you have shown your interest about my job, are you sure? Or are you kidding me?
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
朋友，你似乎對我的工作很感興趣，是真的嗎？還是在跟我開玩笑？

scripts.text: I'm serious!
scripts.translation: 我是認真的！

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Really?
Good. You might have the wrong idea about what a Royal Guard is. So, in your opinion, what do you think is the key to being a Royal Guard?
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
真的嗎？
很好。你可能對皇家衛士有些誤解。那麼，在你看來，成為皇家衛士的關鍵是什麼？

scripts.text: Decision and Bravery
scripts.translation: 決斷與勇氣

scripts.text: Calm Judgment
scripts.translation: 冷靜的判斷

scripts.text: Sharp wisdom
scripts.translation: 敏銳的智慧

scripts.text: Benevolent spirit
scripts.translation: 仁慈的精神

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Good choice.
Actually, the other 3 are also needed to have the Royal Guard spirit, friend.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
不錯的選擇。
其實，要具備皇家衛士的精神，其他三項也是必不可少的，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
But according to research documents about the Royal Guard, the best belief is 'asceticism and endurance'.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
但根據關於皇家衛士的研究文獻，最核心的信念是“苦行與忍耐”。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Did you get it?
Asceticism and Endurance young one. It is a bit different from what you answered.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你明白了嗎？
苦行與忍耐，年輕人。這與你剛才的回答有些不同。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
You seem to have a large interest about this story but I can't tell you more.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你似乎對這個故事很感興趣，但我不能告訴你更多。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Only those who have qualification can hear the Royal Guard history.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
只有具備資格的人，才能聽到皇家衛士的歷史。

scripts.text: What can I do to hear that story?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼做才能聽到那個故事？

scripts.text: ^000099Heinrich has an agonized look on his face. Then he looked like he fell asleep. Finally he says with reckless abandon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099海因裡希臉上露出了痛苦的神情。隨後他似乎睡著了。最後，他毫無顧忌地開口了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
You are too stubborn.
If so I will test you to see your asceticism and endurance.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你太固執了。
既然如此，我就來考驗一下你的苦行與忍耐吧。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Long ago King Schmidtz gave a title to a brave soldier who come back with 100 Sacred Marks.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
很久以前，施密茨國王曾授予一位帶回100枚神聖印記的英勇士兵一個頭銜。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
If you want to hear more story, you have to show me your similar attitude.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
如果你想聽更多的故事，就必須向我展示你擁有同樣的態度。

scripts.text: That's an unfair demand.
scripts.translation: 這要求太不公平了。

scripts.text: I will try.
scripts.translation: 我會試試的。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Good idea, it would better to find something more worthy.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
好主意，還是找點更值得的東西比較好。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Ok, let's do it this way. Actually it's too difficult to collect 100 Sacred Marks, just show your ambition by collecting 100 Burning Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
好吧，就這樣辦。實際上收集100枚神聖印記太難了，收集100顆燃燒的心臟來展示你的雄心壯志吧。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
If you bring them I can tell you more of the story. That means you show your endurance to me.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
如果你把它們帶給我，我就能告訴你更多的故事。這意味著你向我展示了你的忍耐。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Don't forget to bring the 100 Burning Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
別忘了帶來100顆燃燒的心臟。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Wait while I arrange the stuff that you brought.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
等我整理一下你帶來的東西。

scripts.text: Ok tell me more.
scripts.translation: 好的，請繼續說。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
The best members of the Crusader and Paladin classes can gain the qualification of the Royal Guard.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
十字軍和聖殿十字軍中最優秀的成員，才能獲得皇家衛士的資格。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
They are agents of the divine order and judge with swift punishment.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
他們是神聖秩序的特工，以迅速的懲罰進行審判。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
We still have many opinions about how they could have survived. Surely someone had to have believed that their history was not false.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
關於他們是如何倖存下來的，我們仍有許多看法。肯定有人相信他們的歷史並非虛假。

scripts.text: Are there still documents?
scripts.translation: 還有相關的文獻嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Hmm, documents you say...
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
嗯，你說文獻...

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Unfortunately after King Schmidtz disappeared, traces of the Royal Guard disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
不幸的是，施密茨國王消失後，皇家衛士的痕跡也隨之消失了。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Their history, belief, vision and fighting skill seemingly disappeared without any of the documents being saved.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
他們的歷史、信念、願景和戰鬥技巧似乎都消失了，沒有留下任何文獻。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
It's like it disappeared with the king.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
就像隨著國王一起消失了一樣。

scripts.text: So the reason of finding their traces...
scripts.translation: 所以尋找他們蹤跡的原因...

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
I was worried about past Royal Guards that might not have been able to pass down their history.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
我擔心過去的皇家衛士可能無法將他們的歷史傳承下去。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
The mysterious power... can't appear anymore in the world. How disappointing is it~!
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
那種神秘的力量...再也無法在這個世界上出現了。真是令人失望啊~！

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
That's why I'm concentrating to revive their job.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
正因如此，我正致力於復興他們的職業。

scripts.text: How much progress have you made?
scripts.translation: 進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Fortunately, I excavated most of the treasures and interpreted them. I just have one trace left to find.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
幸運的是，我挖掘出了大部分寶物並解讀了它們。只剩下最後一條線索需要尋找了。

scripts.text: The rest of the traces?
scripts.translation: 剩下的線索？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
The Royal Guard carved the mark of King Schmidtz on their clothes. The trace of this custom is the last clue.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
皇家衛士會在衣服上刻下施密茨國王的印記。這一習俗的蹤跡就是最後的線索。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
According to reports from other cities the last trace possibly exists in a monastery inside of Glass Heim.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
根據其他城市的報告，最後的線索可能存在於葛拉斯海姆內部的修道院中。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
But it is too dangerous for me there so I almost gave up.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
但那裡對我來說太危險了，所以我幾乎已經放棄了。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Now I can't tell you why the trace is there.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
現在我還不能告訴你為什麼線索會在那裡。

scripts.text: Interesting. Can I go there?
scripts.translation: 有意思。我可以去那裡嗎？

scripts.text: Seems really dangerous.
scripts.translation: 聽起來真的很危險。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Good idea, that's useless work to explore there.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
好主意，去那裡探索是毫無意義的工作。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Are you kidding?
You shouldn't treat it like it's just some normal chore.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你在開玩笑嗎？
你不應該把它當成普通的差事。

scripts.text: I'm not kidding. I'm serious.
scripts.translation: 我沒開玩笑。我是認真的。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
If you say it like that I don't have any more options.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
既然你這麼說，我也沒有其他選擇了。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
I don't know if it will be helpful or not. I will write an explanation in detail.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
我不知道這是否有用。我會寫一份詳細的說明。

scripts.text: ^000099Here's the last trace of the Royal Guard. Open the quest window and check the position.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099這是皇家衛士的最後線索。開啟任務視窗檢視位置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hainrich]
You surprised me. How did you get it? So far no one could get it.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你讓我很驚訝。你是怎麼得到的？到目前為止還沒有人能拿到它。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Thank you so much.
Thanks to your effort I can find the last clue. How amazing~!
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
非常感謝你。
多虧了你的努力，我才能找到最後的線索。太不可思議了~！

scripts.text: ^000099Heinrich hesitated and brought an old shield from the side of the office.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099海因裡希猶豫了一下，從辦公室旁邊拿出一面舊盾牌。^000000

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Our staff excavated it. They assumed that King Schmidtz used it. But it wasn't used by him.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
這是我們的職員挖掘出來的。他們以為這是施密茨國王用過的，但實際上並不是。

scripts.text: Sure it's wasn't used by the King?
scripts.translation: 確定不是國王用過的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
I can't be entirely sure.
Maybe you are right but, according to when we did the initial identification we can be sure it wasn't used.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
我不能百分之百確定。
也許你是對的，但根據我們最初的鑑定結果，可以確定它沒有被使用過。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
But it's an old treasure so, somehow it will be useful. I might know how to use it.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
不過這是一件古老的寶物，總會有用處的。我可能知道該怎麼用它。

scripts.text: Can I keep it?
scripts.translation: 我可以留著它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Of course.
Someday it might be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
當然可以。
也許有一天它會對你有用。

scripts.text: ^000099You get the shield from Heinrich. There are some letters carved on the inside of the shield.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你從海因裡希那裡拿到了盾牌。盾牌內側刻著一些文字。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099If you want to see the letters, please check the quest window.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099如果你想看那些文字，請檢視任務視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Ok~~ now.
I'll be deciphering the cloth for now so I will be very busy!
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
好了~~現在。
我接下來要破譯那塊布，所以會很忙！

scripts.text:
- Your pack is too heavy. -
- Lighten your body first -
- and please try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你的背包太重了。 -
- 請先減輕負重 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text: Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation: 請卸下你的坐騎再試一次！

scripts.text: ^000099You seem to have lost the shield. Go back to Heinrich and ask for help^000000.
scripts.translation: ^000099你似乎弄丟了盾牌。回到海因裡希那裡尋求幫助^000000。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
你是誰？

scripts.text: I brought a relic...
scripts.translation: 我帶來了一件遺物...

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
My relic?
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
我的遺物？

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Too bad. Here is one more friend who has been cheated by Heinrich.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
真遺憾。這裡又多了一個被海因裡希欺騙的朋友。

scripts.text: Do you know Heinrich?
scripts.translation: 你認識海因裡希嗎？

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
He was my faithful adjutant. And he has continued to be so for hundreds of years.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
他是我忠誠的副官。幾百年來，他一直如此。

scripts.text: How has he lived for hundreds...
scripts.translation: 他怎麼能活幾百...

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Maybe his body is just a cast. He found a way to move from body to body in order to stay alive.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
也許他的身體只是一具軀殼。他找到了轉生的方法，從一個身體轉移到另一個身體，以此延續生命。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
He doesn't want to accept my death and wanders the world, continuing to find Royal Guards.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
他無法接受我的死亡，在世間遊蕩，不斷尋找新的皇家衛士。

scripts.text: What's the meaning of this shield?
scripts.translation: 這面盾牌有什麼意義？

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
The shield from Heinrich is our contract before I died.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
海因裡希的盾牌，是我死前與他訂立的契約。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Heinrich was charged with finding the proper people to become Royal Guards, the shield was to be the contract.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
海因裡希負責尋找合適的人成為皇家衛士，而這面盾牌就是契約的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
To him, this was the last order that I gave to him.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
對他而言，這是我下達給他的最後一道命令。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Now he doesn't need to do it anymore, but will remain as a fool whom can't forget his King's final order.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
現在他本不必再這樣做，但他仍像個傻瓜一樣，無法忘記國王的最後命令。

scripts.text: So what now? Can I leave?
scripts.translation: 那現在怎麼辦？我可以走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Sorry but I can't send you now.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
抱歉，我現在還不能讓你離開。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
This is a contract with Heinrich so I have to keep it. You look faithful and brave.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
這是與海因裡希的契約，我必須遵守。你看起來既忠誠又勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Now, it's time to keep the promise with Heinrich. It's up to you.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
現在，是時候履行與海因裡希的承諾了。一切取決於你。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
I'm planning to accept you as a member of the Royal Guard to continue their lost traditions. Are you ready to do it?
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
我打算接納你成為皇家衛士的一員，以延續他們失落的傳統。你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, of course
scripts.translation: 當然，沒問題

scripts.text: Not yet
scripts.translation: 還沒

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Umm, maybe Heinrich had wrong judgement.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
嗯，也許海因裡希的判斷有誤。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
If so, I will proceed to making you a Royal Guard.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
如果是這樣，我將正式授予你皇家衛士的稱號。

scripts.text: Great.
scripts.translation: 太好了。

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Perhaps Heinrich had the wrong image of you.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
也許海因裡希對你的印象有誤。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Look at your body before that!
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
看看你現在的樣子吧！

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Congratulations! Young Royal Guard.
Be a symbol of honor and continue the great tradition of your new name.
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
恭喜！年輕的皇家衛士。
請成為榮譽的象徵，延續你新名字的偉大傳統。

scripts.text:
[Memory of King Schmidtz]
Are still sentimentally attached to yourself?
You cannot inherit the Royal Guard!
scripts.translation:
[施密茨國王的記憶]
你仍然對自己抱有留戀之情嗎？
你無法繼承皇家衛士的稱號！

scripts.text: While investigating, the topography breaks. It would be better to dig other places for a while.
scripts.translation: 在調查過程中，地形發生了斷裂。最好暫時去其他地方挖掘。

scripts.text: There is a trace that someone has already dug here.
scripts.translation: 這裡似乎有人已經挖掘過的痕跡。

scripts.text: I can feel strong power around here. It would be better to explore around here.
scripts.translation: 我能感覺到這裡附近有強大的力量。最好在這裡周圍探索一下。

scripts.text: Royal Guard
scripts.translation: 皇家衛士

scripts.text: Rune Knight
scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士

scripts.text: Sorcerer
scripts.translation: 妖術師
